physical.physical_description: Shoulder cloth (slendang) of cotton batik. The field is patterned diagonally with a parang motive, alternating with bands containing stylised flowers and leaves, some incorporating 'husked grains of rice' (galah sinawur). The central area is broken by an elongated lozenge (blumbangan) bordered with a frieze of small leaves (rjekmukirran).

physical.physical_description: Head cloth of cotton batik. Waxed with the tjanting and dyed indigo and brown on a cream ground. The field is patterned with a parang motif, and in each corned is repeated a wing (lar) motif incorporating a broad tail. The centre of the field is broken by a lozenge (modang) bordered with a frieze of small stylised leaves (tjekmukirran).
